```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_record <- 2010L # records cover every FBS season from 2010
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
fbs_seasons <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(
    classification == "fbs",
    season >= first_record,
    season <= last_season
  ) |>
  collect()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
#| output: false
school <- school_record(fbs_seasons, credited)
tier_levels <- levels(school$tier)
# Each tier's correlation of win % with draft rate, and its plausible range.
win_cor <- school |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  group_modify(\(g, k) {
    ct <- cor.test(g$win_pct, g$draft_rate)
    tibble::tibble(
      schools = nrow(g),
      r = unname(ct$estimate),
      lo = ct$conf.int[1],
      hi = ct$conf.int[2]
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup()
r_of <- function(t) win_cor$r[win_cor$tier == t]
fits <- fit_tier_curves(school, "win_pct")
at60 <- vapply(
  fits,
  \(m) unname(predict(m, newdata = data.frame(win_pct = 0.6), type = "response")),
  numeric(1)
)
grid <- school |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  reframe(win_pct = seq(min(win_pct), max(win_pct), length.out = 100)) |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  mutate(
    fit = predict(
      fits[[as.character(first(tier))]],
      newdata = pick(everything()),
      type = "response"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
school$tip <- paste0(
  school$team,
  " (",
  school$tier,
  ")\nRecord 2010 to 2025: ",
  school$record_label,
  " (",
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * school$win_pct),
  "); ",
  school$drafted,
  " drafted of ",
  school$eligible,
  " eligible (",
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * school$draft_rate),
  ")"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(school, aes(win_pct, draft_rate, color = tier)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    size = 3.4,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_line(data = grid, aes(y = fit), linewidth = 1.6) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.22,
    y = 0.36,
    label = sprintf(
      "Power: r = %.2f\nGroup of 5: r = %.2f",
      r_of("Power"),
      r_of("Group of 5")
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#111827"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_palette()[tier_levels], name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Win % (FBS seasons 2010 to 2025)",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Draft rate rises with win % in both tiers",
    subtitle = "Each dot is a school; lines are each tier's fitted curve",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "win-pct-and-draft-rate", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
p_explore <- ggplot(school, aes(win_pct, draft_rate)) +
  geom_line(data = grid, aes(y = fit), color = "#9ca3af", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(fill = team, tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.2,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tier, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_team(teams, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Win % (FBS seasons 2010 to 2025)",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Every FBS school's record and draft rate",
    subtitle = "Team colors; each panel has its own vertical scale; hover a dot for the record and counts",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_explore, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
win_cor |>
  transmute(
    Tier = tier,
    Schools = schools,
    `Correlation of win % with draft rate (r)` = sprintf("%.2f", r),
    `Plausible range of r` = paste(sprintf("%.2f", lo), "to", sprintf("%.2f", hi)),
    `Expected draft rate at a 60% win %` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * at60[as.character(tier)])
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Tier", "Schools", "Correlation of win % with draft rate (r)",
      "Plausible range of r", "Expected draft rate at a 60% win %"
    ),
    caption = "School win % (FBS seasons 2010 to 2025) against draft rate (final seasons 2013 to 2025), by tier. A correlation near 1 means schools with higher win % sit on a rising line of draft rates; the plausible range is the span the true correlation likely falls in (a 95% confidence interval). The expected draft rate comes from the tier's fitted curve."
  )
```
